name: ninmagic-saves
target: Nintendo Switch homebrew NRO under Atmosphere
primary_required_workflow: Read network/airplane notice, reboot and reopen same NRO on sysMMC; network diagnosis is informational
Enumerate and copy original account/device saves read-only to SD
Map copies to matching existing saves and chosen destination accounts
Verify destination backup, ask confirmation, restore, verify, retain recovery
hardware_specific_reboot: Erista one-shot Hekate; manual handoff on Mariko or unsupported configuration
match_games_by: Program/Title ID and save kind, not source user name
multiple_source_saves: User selects distinct saves; never silently merge
before_overwriting_destination: Verified backup and explicit in-app confirmation
updates: Own public HTTPS channel; network updater only in verified emuMMC
status: 0.2.2 beta compiled and host-tested; physical-console validation pending
